dialect.label: Fanuc Series 0 / 00 / 0-Mate
dialect.about: The 1990s Fanuc Series 0 machining center control. It reads like the 0i-F mill but has no inverse time feed (G93), uses G150-G152 for normal direction control and G05 for high-speed cycle machining.

callDepth.source: Fanuc Series 0-M: 2 subprogram levels, 4 with the macro option, 4 macro levels

source.manual: FANUC Series 0/00/0-Mate Operator's Manual, Machining Center B-61404E/08
source.section: G code list (pp. 28-31), dwell (p. 63), subprograms (p. 129); see docs/manual-reviews/fanuc-lathe-and-series-0.md

G93.text: The Fanuc Series 0 has no inverse time feed (G93).
